description_en: Perform a paged query to retrieve information about all Custom detection libraries under the current User
description_zh: 分页查询当前用户下的所有自定义识别库信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-recognition-libs --algorithm landmark --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --lib-id lib1,lib2,lib3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecognitionLibs

parameters.help_en:
The type of recognition algorithm. Valid values:

landmark

object

logo

face

label
parameters.help_zh:
识别类型，取值：

landmark：自定义地标。

object：自定义物体。

logo：自定义logo

face：自定义人脸

label：自定义标签
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。单页数量最大不超过 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Library ID. If provided, the query returns only this specific library. A list of IDs separated by commas (",") is also supported
parameters.help_zh: 库ID，传入则精确查该库；支持传入列表，用","分割
parameters.name: lib_id
